description: This file defines string replacement functions (`absl::StrReplaceAll`) for performing efficient, large-scale text substitutions within strings, including in-place modifications. It includes function overloads for different input types and internal implementation details.

classes.name: ViableSubstitution
classes.description: Internal structure representing a potential string substitution with position and size for prioritization.

methods.name: StrReplaceAll
methods.description: Performs string replacements based on a list or container of key-value pairs, returning a new string with substitutions.

methods.name: StrReplaceAll
methods.description: Performs in-place string replacements based on a list or container of key-value pairs, returning the number of substitutions made.
